user.title: Connect to HA-Storage & K-Ruoka
user.description: Enter your HA-Storage instance URL and the K-Ruoka store ID. These settings are required to search for products and add them to Storage.

init.description: Configure optional features such as product image uploading and Gemini AI.

data_description.upload_images: Download and upload product images when creating new products
data_description.use_graphql: Use the faster GraphQL backend; disable only if you need the kr-api fallback
data_description.gemini_api_key: Google Gemini API key used by the Sort, Date, Group, and Optimize actions
data_description.gemini_model_optimize: Override model for Optimize action; leave blank to use the default model
